name: IP Geolocation Lookup
description: Retrieve geolocation details (country, city, region, ASN, ISP, coordinates) for a single IP address. Supports both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses. Use this action to enrich events with location data, perform fraud detection, or geo-target users. [See the documentation](https://whoisfreaks.com/documentation/ip-geolocation-api#geo-lookup)
